headline: Pacific Blue Cross says a cyber incident took down its website and contact centre; it has not said if it was an attack or data was taken.
summary: New incident page. CBC (s001, read as carried in full by Yahoo News Canada, s002; CBC's own page blocked) and Vista Radio's My Prince George Now (s003) each report the company's statements: a "cyber incident" first noticed early Nov 25 disrupted some systems; website and contact centre unavailable; contained, restoring securely with external specialists; members to keep claims and receipts; no restoration estimate; no word on cause or personal data. A member told Vista Radio they paid cash for prescriptions. Main answer Not established, filed under unclear: the company has not said whether anyone got in. incident_type outage; service down (c002, Confirmed on two outlets). Size Regional. Company website answered 503, so no notice could be read or captured. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; no Reddit thread found; the RedFlagDeals forum thread could not be read (paywalled gateway). Photograph: Burnaby Metrotown skyline (CC BY-SA 4.0). Privacy check done: no private people, bylines, handles or phone numbers.
author: Research agent
